dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: by working diligently enough to be acknowledged and liked by a capo.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Amazing.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Seriously? This took a sudden turn for the awesome.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Where is it?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Where'd you hide that kind of fortune on Capri, Bucciarati?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I can't tell you that yet.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Rumors of his hidden fortune have made the rounds in the organization.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: No one can find out before we secure the money.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: B-Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Hey! Something's wrong!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Did something happen, Narancia?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Narancia!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What the heck are you doing?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: H-Hey, come look at this!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: There's only one shoe left...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Give that here, Giorno!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: I don't quite understand what's going on.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Where did Narancia go?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You guys didn't see it?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: To me, it looked like Narancia got pulled into this box.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: What?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: That's impossible!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: He didn't randomly fall into the ocean, did he?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Narancia, where are you?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Hey, Narancia! If you're just fooling around and hiding... Hup!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Hurry up and answer us!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Narancia, where are you?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Narancia! Answer us!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Mista?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: What are you doing, Mista?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Mista?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Where did you go, Mista?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It can't be...

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Come on, Mista!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Why are you messing around now—

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Fugo?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Hey, Fugo!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: What?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: What's going on?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Abbacchio, Giorno, stay close to each other!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: We're being attacked!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: There's someone hiding somewhere on this boat!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: This is a Stand attack!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: But why now?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: The money.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Someone found out that I knew where the money was,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: and they're trying to steal it.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Which means they're from the organization.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Does that mean they've been quietly tracking us ever since we were on the shore?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Looks that way.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: They probably grew impatient because I wouldn't just say where the money is.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: They intend to get rid of everyone but me, then make me cough up the location.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: And they can take their time, since we're on the ocean with nowhere to run.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Are you saying Narancia and the others are dead?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I didn't say that.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: But it's for ten billion.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: They'd even k*ll someone from their own organization for that.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: No, Narancia and the others are alive.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: They're somewhere on this boat.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I don't know if this person is trying to use them as hostages,

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: but they're alive.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Giorno Giovanna,

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: how the hell can you be so sure about that?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I used my Stand to turn Narancia's shoe into a fly.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: The fly is trying to return to its owner, Narancia.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: If Narancia was truly dead, it wouldn't be flying around searching like that.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Can you locate him?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: He's alive... He's alive, but...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It's not going down into the cabin or in the locker.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: The fly's not trying to stop...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: It keeps flying around that area looking for Narancia.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: What the hell is his ability?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Just shut up and listen.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Narancia is somewhere near the entrance to the cabin.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: That's a fact.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: But for some reason, the fly can't find him, so it's lost.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I think it's safe to assume that we'll find the enemy wherever Narancia is.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Which means the enemy isn't just randomly hiding behind something.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I see.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: So if we don't figure out the mystery behind the enemy's ability,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: getting too close without knowing could get us k*lled.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Correct.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: But the fact that their ability requires them to attack while hidden is a shortcoming.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: If we can figure out the mystery behind it, we'll be able to defeat them.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Abbacchio, your Stand...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: might be perfect to defeat such an enemy.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Defeat?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Can you solve this mystery with your ability?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Hard to say...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Damn it, Abbacchio!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You'd better not be hung up on stupid sh*t at a time like this!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Stupid sh*t?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: No.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: This has to do with my safety.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I can't just carelessly reveal my Stand ability

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: in front of a stranger that I can't trust.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati,

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I don't know what made you trust this guy,

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: but I don't consider him a part of the team.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: If we don't figure out the enemy's location, we're going to be k*lled!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: And I'm saying that's just this untrustworthy brat's hypothesis.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: He just came up with it out of fear. He didn't see anything.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Abbacchio!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: The enemy is just hiding somewhere in the cabin.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I'll find them and take care of them.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: If we get close without figuring out the mystery, we're going to get kil—

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Shut your mouth!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: You stupid little brat...

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I, Giorno Giovanna, have a dream.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: What are you talking about?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: You can solve the mystery, right?

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I'm counting on you!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Giorno!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: What the hell are you doing?!

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: Roar

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: G-Giorno!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: There's an enemy over there!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: sh*t!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Giorno's in trouble!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Abbacchio...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Giorno Giovanna... You're one crazy b*stard.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: All this to prove yourself...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: What the hell is wrong with you?
